details:
Hi,
I would love to see advanced settings for IK2.0 please. Similar to what 'you-know-what' offered. After the EAC update I'm forced to use IK2.0 vanilla and it is a degraded experience from what I had before.
I understand that many issues can be down to the way an avatar is rigged and so on, but without proper means of testing a rig live, the process of making a rig perfect can be impossible for some models. Especially since people have different body types and so on, you can't really make a one size fits all IK. We need to have settings that let us adjust it to our own liking and at the moment the settings given are incredibly basic.
There should be advanced settings in VRChat that allow users to have way more control over the game. Something like Neos, but tucked away so it's not intrusive/overwhelming for newcomers.
With default IK2.0 I am having issues where my chest pokes out when sitting down, my neck bend angle is not as responsive as it was before and so on. Every avatar I use has issues and I was able to immediately fix them with 'you-know-what'. I use 11 point tracking and I have tried all measurement/locking configs and I can't get it as good as before.
One thing I could also do before was use locking on both hip + head without issues. 'you-know-what' allowed for adjusting spine angles so I could use this setting on most avatars and it looked great. But now, with almost every avatar I have used, it actually looks terrible. The stomach just caves into itself and the neck breaks etc, so many issues.
This isn't an issue with IK 2.0, it's the fact you give us no control over any offsets or maximum bend goals for bones etc. We are all built different lol. Please give us more control over the IK since in many situations people use public avatars and don't have the option to fix issues on the avatar itself.
Having more IK control was a perfect system around this and other platforms have these options without confusing the user. It would be optional and reset-able for anyone it could overwhelm.
I would love to see the following if possible (credit to Knah for many of the below suggestion ideas):
Pre-straighten spine (improve IK stability) - if enabled, you avatar's spine will be forcefully straightened before solving it. This reduces flippiness/jitter on avatars that have spine bent backwards by default.
Spine Relax Iterations - how much work will be done on bending the spine.
Maximum bend angles - how much spine/neck can be bent forward/back. If your spine bends too much to your taste or looks cursed on your specific avatar, reduce these angles. Angle limits are ignored in "lock both" mode.
Neck bend priority - neck will bend this much faster than the spine. This is intended to handle the fact that people move their neck way more than their spine, so IK should start off by bending it, not spine.
Straight spine angle - within this angle from perfectly straight, the spine will be considered almost straight and maximum bend angles will be reduced.
Straight spine power - controls the curve with which the spine transitions from straight to bend within the straight angle.
Hand angles/offsets for controllers.
Shoulder tracking power - Change how much influence elbows have on shoulders for those with shoulder tracking enabled. 
Custom avatar viewpoints, stores per avatar and with a shift limit so people can't move it too far away from its original position in unity. Just small adjustments to make it perfect for their liking.
Systems like these are especially needed for people with non standard setups like IMU based/Camera based etc. And it's incredibly beneficial to literally every FBT user. Nobody as of now has perfect FBT and this is the solution. Neos has these kinds of controls and their FBT system has always been ahead of vanilla VRChat. But I preferred VRChats IK when using Knahs 'upgrade'. I'd love to see these settings here. Thank you.
title: More advanced settings for IK2.0/Avatars
